verdict.rationale: Convex offers self-hosting, giving full ownership/control over where and how long data is stored (convex-docs-8/19/30/40), which implicitly supports retention/deletion control, but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of deletion APIs, TTL/retention policies, or data-export-then-purge workflows for the managed cloud offering. missing for 10: explicit deletion/retention API or policy docs, GDPR-style data purge guidance, managed-cloud retention controls, independent verification of deletion behavior.
